inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Process Running from Root of ProgramData Dir

native_rule.creator: bhanu.nandanampati@nopalcyber.com
native_rule.name: [NopalCyber] Process Running from Root of ProgramData Dir
native_rule.s1ql:
(
  event.category = 'Process'
  AND event.type = 'Process Creation'
)
AND
(
  tgt.process.cmdline RegExp '
  (
    ?i
  )
  (
    \\ProgramData\\[a-zA-Z0-9]{1,20}\.
    (
      exe|dll|ocx|vbs|vbe|jar|jse|bat|wpl|dat|bin|rtf|png|jpg
    )
  )
  '
  AND NOT
  (
    tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'uninstall'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'Arete'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'senti'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'alternateshell.exe'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'logonsession.exe'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'FWAInstallMonitor.exe'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'notepad'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase '\VDT.exe'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'Install'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase '\Program Files'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'Setup'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'Clean'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'Viewer'
  )
  AND NOT
  (
    src.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'mcafee'
    OR src.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'malwarebytes'
    OR src.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'symantec'
    OR src.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'Adobe'
    OR src.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'monitor'
    OR src.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'AfterFX.exe'
    OR src.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'SynTPEnh.exe'
    OR src.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'Trend Micro'
  )
)
